METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

3. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.

4. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Forging.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.

5. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

7. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

10. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.

11. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.

12. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Forging and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Finishing Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Project 2 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Career Opportunities in Metalwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
